name: Quemado Beach
hero_subtitle: Al Hoceima’s main urban beach — golden sand, easy town access and the everyday face of the bay.

overview.title: The city’s beach
overview.p1: Quemado Beach is the sandy front of Al Hoceima town — the place most visitors swim first and the easiest shoreline to reach on foot or by short taxi.
overview.p2: Expect a classic urban Mediterranean beach: services in season, families, and clear views across the bay. It is practical rather than wild; for quieter coves head to Cala Bonita or the park coast.
overview.p3: Bring sun protection and plan shade in peak summer. Evenings on the nearby corniche pair well with a Quemado afternoon.

q1.question: Is Quemado Beach free?
q1.answer: Yes. It is a public urban beach. Loungers or umbrellas from private operators are optional and paid.

q2.question: Best time of day?
q2.answer: Morning for quieter sand; late afternoon for softer light and a cooler swim.

q3.question: Facilities?
q3.answer: In season you will find cafés, showers and basic services along the front.

q4.question: Safe for families?
q4.answer: Generally yes in calm conditions; always watch children near the water.

q5.question: How long to spend?
q5.answer: Two to four hours is typical; full days work if you like urban beach life.
